title: CREATE_CLAIMABLE_BALANCE fails with CREATE_CLAIMABLE_BALANCE_LOW_RESERVE
pattern: A transaction whose CREATE_CLAIMABLE_BALANCE operation fails at apply is still written into the closed ledger: its fee is charged, its sequence number is consumed, and nothing it did is kept. The result carries the operation's code (low_reserve). The operation source holds 10 NRV but sits at its minimum XLM balance; a claimable balance needs 0.5 XLM of reserve from its creator. Another account pays the transaction fee.

hazards.placement: claimable balance whose creator cannot fund its reserve

facts.says: No operation changed state: the operation meta is empty.
The fee is still charged: the fee source changes in fee processing.
